cases.intent: Audit the checkout page for accessibility before we ship — screen reader and contrast issues included.
cases.notes: WCAG 2.2 AA audit of an existing page (description: Use when auditing a page or component for accessibility).

cases.intent: Design the REST endpoints for the new billing API and define the contract between frontend and backend.
cases.notes: API / interface design, not implementation.

cases.intent: Open the dashboard in a real browser and tell me what console errors appear on load.
cases.notes: Real-browser runtime data via Chrome DevTools MCP.

cases.intent: Set up the CI pipeline so tests and lint run on every pull request, and automate the deploy to staging.
cases.notes: Pipeline setup / deployment automation, not a quality bar (that is constraint-driven-development).

cases.intent: Review this pull request diff before I merge it — check quality across the board.
cases.notes: Code diff review before merge; reviewing a Skill goes to skill-evaluation-gate instead.

cases.intent: This function works but it is a nested mess — clean it up without changing what it does.
cases.notes: Refactor for clarity, behaviour unchanged.

cases.intent: Set up constraints for this project so the agent stops shipping junk — define our standards with real numbers.
cases.notes: No quality bar written down yet; user asks to 'set up constraints' / 'define our standards'.

cases.intent: I am starting a new session on the auth module — set up the context so the agent follows our conventions.
cases.notes: Session start / rules-file setup; output quality degrades without it.

cases.intent: The build broke after yesterday's merge and nothing obvious changed — find what broke and why.
cases.notes: Systematic root-cause debugging, not a known fix.

cases.intent: We need to remove the old v1 API and migrate users to v2 without downtime.
cases.notes: Deprecation / migration of a live system.

cases.intent: Write an architecture decision record for why we chose Postgres, and check the docs have not drifted from the code.
cases.notes: ADR + documentation drift detection.

cases.intent: This change touches production auth — cross-examine every assumption before we proceed.
cases.notes: High-stakes, non-trivial decision; fresh-context adversarial review. Cross-model is offered, never silent.

cases.intent: Build the settings page UI — production-quality, responsive, accessible.
cases.notes: Engineering UI implementation; visual direction already decided (otherwise visual-design first).

cases.intent: Split this messy working tree into clean atomic commits and write the changelog entry.
cases.notes: Commit hygiene / release mechanics.

cases.intent: I have a vague idea for a referral program — stress-test it before I commit to a plan.
cases.notes: Divergent / convergent refinement of a vague idea; trigger phrase 'stress-test my plan'.

cases.intent: This feature touches six files — land it in thin verifiable slices, not one big bang.
cases.notes: Multi-file change delivered incrementally.

cases.intent: I have a vague idea for an app but I do not know what I want yet — ask me questions until it is clear.
cases.notes: Same name as the native skill by design. This case proves the NAME is routed; the routing target is the NATIVE interview-me — the vendored copy is reference-only and never installed (see docs/dedup-decisions.md).

cases.intent: Add logging and metrics to the checkout service — when production breaks we currently cannot tell what happened.
cases.notes: Production visibility: logs / metrics / traces / alerting.

cases.intent: The dashboard is slow — profile it and fix the N+1 queries dragging down load time.
cases.notes: Measured bottleneck; profiling reveals it.

cases.intent: Here is the spec for the billing feature — break it into ordered implementable tasks and estimate the scope.
cases.notes: Spec exists; decompose into tasks. Mapping a real user journey goes to feature-journey-map instead.

cases.intent: Audit the login flow for vulnerabilities against the OWASP Top Ten before we ship.
cases.notes: Security audit of an input / auth handler.

cases.intent: We are deploying to production Friday — what needs to be in place before shipping, and what is the rollback plan?
cases.notes: Pre-launch checklist + staged rollout + rollback.

cases.intent: Verify this approach against the official docs before implementing — I want source-cited code, not outdated patterns.
cases.notes: Ground implementation in official documentation.

cases.intent: We are starting a new project and there is no specification yet — draft the requirements first.
cases.notes: No spec exists; spec before code.

cases.intent: Write a failing test for this bug before fixing it — red first, then green.
cases.notes: New logic / behaviour change: failing test first. A reported defect needing independent verification goes to verified-change-loop.

cases.intent: Which skill should handle this request? I do not know where to start.
cases.notes: Meta / discovery question. using-agent-skills is the discovery flowchart CHEF consults, not a task skill.

description: Intent -> expected-skill routing cases for the 26 vendored skills (addyosmani/agent-skills v0.6.18, vendor/). One case per vendored skill, 26 total. Checked by evals/run_vendor_evals.py: the expected skill must exist under vendor/addy-agent-skills/skills/ and be named by skills/chef-orchestrator/SKILL.md. The interview-me case proves the name is routed; the routing target is the native interview-me (vendored copy is reference-only). Scenario ideas follow the upstream evals/cases trigger prompts, rewritten in this repo's case format — no upstream files are copied.
